# Retirement preserves archive and control evidence
Retire `mgr-alpha` with `life-retire`. The operation first marks the registry non-dispatchable, drains runs, exports session `sess-mgr-alpha-01`, and waits for a committed checkpoint before removing live profile state.
```text GET /chd/registry/mgr-alpha -> state=retired, dispatchable=false GET /chd-archive/sessions/mgr-alpha/mgr-alpha-p1/sess-mgr-alpha-01 -> state=frozen GET /chd-archive/sessions/mgr-alpha/mgr-alpha-p1/sess-mgr-alpha-01/ck-*/manifest -> state=committed GET /chd/audit/* -> credential_revoked + profile_removed + retirement_committed GET /v1/admin/profiles/mgr-alpha-p1 -> 404 not_found ```
The archive remains readable only with an explicit archive grant and selector. If the run status is `unknown` or the archive manifest is incomplete, the profile is retained and the result is `capacity_lease_unproven` or `archive_incomplete`; no false retirement acknowledgement is returned.
